target: Sole Proprietorship / Small Business Opening in City of Manila

stages.portal_or_location: BNRS Portal (bnrs.dti.gov.ph) or DTI Regional/NCRO Office

steps.title: Business Name Search & Verification
steps.description: Search the DTI BNRS database to ensure proposed business name compliance and availability.
steps.details: Must satisfy DTI guidelines: not dominant, not offensive, no illegal words, and not identical to existing trademarks.

steps.title: Select Territorial Scope & Pay Fee
steps.description: Choose territorial jurisdiction which determines business coverage and fee structure.
steps.details: Barangay: ₱200 | City/Municipality (Manila): ₱500 | Regional: ₱1,000 | National: ₱2,000 (plus ₱30 Documentary Stamp Tax).

steps.title: Certificate Issuance
steps.description: Receive DTI Certificate of Business Name Registration.
steps.details: Valid for 5 years. Download digital certificate or print for physical filing.

key_outputs: DTI Certificate of Business Name Registration (BNR)

stages.agency: Local Barangay (Specific Manila Barangay where shop is located)
stages.portal_or_location: Barangay Hall of specific Manila Barangay / Zone
prerequisites: Proof of Business Location (Lease Contract or Tax Declaration)

steps.title: Submit Documents to Barangay Hall
steps.description: Present DTI Certificate, Lease Agreement or Land Title/Tax Declaration, and Owner's Valid ID.
steps.details: If renting, lease contract must be signed by lessor and lessee. If home-based, authorization from land/property owner.

steps.title: Barangay Inspection & Fee Payment
steps.description: Pay Barangay Clearance Fee (varies by barangay ordinance, typically ₱300 - ₱1,000).
steps.details: Barangay official may inspect physical establishment to confirm location validity.

steps.title: Issuance of Barangay Business Clearance
steps.description: Claim signed Barangay Clearance and Official Receipt.
steps.details: Required prerequisite for Manila Mayor's Permit application.

stages.agency: City Planning & Development Office (CPDO) / Manila Health Dept (MHD) / BFP Manila
stages.portal_or_location: Manila City Hall Annex / Line Bureau Offices

steps.title: Locational / Zoning Clearance
steps.description: Verify land use compatibility with Manila City Land Use & Zoning Ordinance.
steps.details: Issued by CPDO Manila City Hall. Required to ensure business activity is allowed in location zone.

steps.title: Sanitary Permit & Health Cards (MHD)
steps.description: Mandatory for food establishments, retail, personal care, and public-facing shops.
steps.details: Employees must undergo X-ray, Stool/Urine exam to secure Manila Yellow Health Card. Sanitary inspection conducted.

steps.title: Fire Safety Inspection Certificate (FSIC) Pre-assessment
steps.description: Submit floor plan and inspection request to Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP Manila).
steps.details: Requires compliant fire extinguishers (dry chemical / HCFC), emergency signs, and clear exit pathways.

key_outputs: BFP FSIC Order of Payment / Clearance

stages.stage_name: GO! Manila Mayor's Business Permit Application
stages.agency: Business Permits and Licensing Service (BPLS) - City of Manila
stages.portal_or_location: GO! Manila Online Portal (gomanila.com) / BPLS City Hall
prerequisites: Proof of Address (Lease Contract / Tax Dec)

steps.title: Account Creation & E-GOVERNMENT Module Selection
steps.description: Register on GO! Manila portal (gomanila.com) and navigate to E-GOVERNMENT > Go! BPLS.
steps.details: Select 'New Business Application' and enter basic business entity details.

steps.title: Document Upload & Location Pinning
steps.description: Fill out capital investment details, line of business, and upload scanned PDF/image requirements.
steps.details: Pin exact shop address on integrated map tool. Agree to terms and submit for online assessment.

steps.title: Statement of Account (SOA) Generation
steps.description: BPLS reviews application and generates Statement of Account (SOA).
steps.details: SOA breakdown includes: Local Business Tax, Mayor's Permit Fee, Sanitary Fee, Garbage Fee, Fire Inspection Fee.

steps.title: Payment Settlement
steps.description: Pay online via GO! Manila (E-wallets, Online Banking, Cards) or Over-the-Counter / Bayad Center.
steps.details: Save payment reference and receipt screenshot.

steps.title: Download Official Permit & Plate
steps.description: Access History tab in GO! Manila to view and download digital Mayor's Business Permit and E-OR.
steps.details: Print and display prominently at business site alongside physical business plate.

stages.stage_name: BIR Tax Registration & Authority to Print
stages.agency: Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) - Revenue District Office (RDO Manila)
stages.portal_or_location: Respective Manila RDO (e.g., RDO 29, 30, 31, 32, 33, or 34 depending on district)

steps.title: Submit BIR Form 1901
steps.description: Submit Application for Registration for Sole Proprietors to assigned Manila RDO.
steps.details: Pay Annual Registration Fee (if applicable under current tax rules) and Documentary Stamp Tax on Lease Contract.

steps.title: Register Books of Accounts
steps.description: Purchase and present standard accounting books (Journal, Ledger, Cash Receipts, Cash Disbursements).
steps.details: RDO stamps books for official compliance.

steps.title: Authority to Print (ATP) Receipts / Invoices
steps.description: Apply for ATP (BIR Form 1906) or register BIR-accredited E-Invoicing / POS system.
steps.details: Print official receipts/sales invoices via BIR-accredited printer.

steps.title: Certificate of Registration (COR - Form 2303) & Asking for Receipt Sign
steps.description: Receive BIR Form 2303 detailing tax obligations (Percentage Tax / VAT, Income Tax, Withholding Tax).
steps.details: Display COR Form 2303 and 'Notice to the Public' (Ask for Receipt) poster at business cashier.

bmbe_bonus_note.title: Optional Cost Saving: BMBE Registration (RA 9178)
bmbe_bonus_note.benefit: Exemption from Income Tax for assets under ₱3,000,000 (excluding land).
bmbe_bonus_note.where_to_apply: DTI Portal / DTI NCRO after securing DTI Certificate and Mayor's Permit.
